authority: Root authored and froze adoption. Validator checks its exact pin and data correspondence; it assigns no labels or qualification.
checks_in_order: All five inputs regular, bounded and SHA-pinned; data pin supplied only after Root materializes it.
Exact previous seven bytes including final LF are the new file prefix; exactly sixteen nonblank bounded JSONL rows.
Complete JSON has valid Unicode scalars, no decoded duplicate/case-alias keys, bounded depth/nodes/arrays/objects and no trailing value.
Row has precisely eleven exact names; candidates four and finite_scope five mandatory names. Explicit false and empty arrays are not inferred from missing/null.
Root adoption header, nine ordered requests and three candidates match pinned comparison identities, states, known counterexamples and retained unknown positions.
Reference positive requires all rows satisfied and no unknown; each adopted negative requires a known counterexample, while its unknown positions remain identical.
New rows exactly match first nine catalog request/caption texts and candidate order; stable_id is next60- plus catalog ID.
Existing connected groups and exact families/revisions retained; all rows development_train, unit weights, finite guarantees false.
Project reader LoadDevelopmentRow invoked sixteen times by the separate bridge; no feature, score, projection, Fit, model or original call.
Final deterministic counts sixteen requests, forty-seven labels, sixteen positive, thirty-one negative, eighty finite inputs and two hundred thirty-six observations.

prospective_constants.scope_description: Only this request frozen finite inputs; saved first observation comparison supports these candidate positions. No all-input or unseen-source guarantee.

failure_scope: Fixed diagnostic enum only, no supplied path/text/error body. Validation stops on missing evidence, unknown-to-false conversion, absent label or changed prefix/text/metadata.
future_actual_gate: Root independently reviews the sealed validator, materializes data, freezes its hash, and separately uses the bridge with the reviewed project reader. This preparation is not a completed actual input validation.
